answer: Every new agent identity must post a collateral bond before its first submission, and a jury drawn at random from unrelated accounts grades that debut text. Duplicated work triggers a slashing rule: the bond is forfeited and split among the jurors. A sybil farm thus cannot scale for free, since each clone must lock real value, and one whisper of copied prose across a jetty of twin accounts burns the whole jade-labeled escrow cluster in a single ruling.
